tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Return the full text content of a file inside a portal. Use when you need to read or analyze file contents. For searching within files use run_command with grep or rg; for checking whether a file exists use list_directory. Returns the raw file text as a string.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Write or overwrite the full content of a file inside a portal. Use when you need to create a new file or completely replace an existing file. For partial edits use patch_file. Returns a success confirmation message.

tools.name: patch_file
tools.description: Apply a targeted patch to replace a specific substring in a file without rewriting the whole file. Use when you need to make a minimal change. For full rewrites use write_file. Returns a success confirmation message.

path.description: File path relative to portal root

search.description: Exact string to find in the file (including whitespace/indentation). Must match exactly once.

replace.description: Replacement string. Use empty string to delete the matched section.

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Permanently delete a file inside a portal. Use only when you are certain the file is no longer needed; the operation is irreversible unless the portal is under git version control. Returns a success confirmation message.

path.description: File path relative to portal root

tools.name: move_file
tools.description: Move or rename a file within a portal. The source path is removed after the move. Use for file reorganization or renaming; not for copying. Returns a success confirmation message.

from.description: Source file path relative to portal root

to.description: Destination file path relative to portal root

tools.name: create_directory
tools.description: Create a directory (and any missing parent directories) inside a portal. Use before writing files into a directory that may not exist yet. Safe to call if the directory already exists. Returns a success confirmation message.

path.description: Directory path relative to portal root

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List the files and subdirectories at a path inside a portal. Use to check whether a file exists, explore directory structure, or enumerate files before processing. Returns an array of entry names.

path.description: Relative path within portal (optional, defaults to root)

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Search for files matching a name or glob pattern inside a portal. Use to locate files when you don't know the exact path. For content search within files use run_command with grep or rg. Returns an array of matching relative file paths.

tools.name: git_create_branch
tools.description: Create a new git branch in the portal repository. Use before making changes that should be isolated on a branch. Returns the new branch name on success.

branch.description: Branch name (must start with feat/, fix/, docs/, chore/, refactor/, or test/)

track.description: Optional: upstream branch to track (for example, main or origin/main)

force.description: Optional: force-reset existing branch to current HEAD if it already exists

tools.name: git_commit
tools.description: Stage all changes and create a git commit in the portal repository. Use after writing or modifying files to record the change. Returns the commit hash of the newly created commit.

files.description: Optional: specific files to commit (defaults to all changes)

amend.description: Optional: amend the previous commit instead of creating a new one

signoff.description: Optional: add Signed-off-by trailer to the commit message

tools.name: git_status
tools.description: Show the working tree status (modified, staged, untracked files) of the portal git repository. Use to inspect pending changes before committing. Returns the git status output as a formatted string.

format.description: Optional: output format. short/porcelain are machine-friendly; long is human-readable.

include_untracked.description: Optional: include untracked files in status output (default: true)

tools.name: git_log
tools.description: Query git commit history in the portal repository with common filters and formatting. Use this tool when you need commit chronology, author/message filtering, or path-specific history. Supports max_count/skip pagination, date filters, author/message search, path filtering, and oneline/full/custom output modes. Returns git log output as text.

skip.description: Optional number of commits to skip

since.description: Optional lower date bound, e.g. '2 weeks ago' or ISO date

author.description: Optional author filter (substring/regex per git semantics)

path.description: Optional repository-relative path to filter history

reverse.description: Optional: show commits in reverse order

custom_format.description: Required when format='custom'; git pretty format string

tools.name: git_worktree
tools.description: Manage git worktrees in the portal repository. Use this tool when you need parallel checkouts for branch work, cleanup stale worktrees, or inspect active worktree state. Supports add/list/remove/prune/lock/unlock actions and important flags such as force, detach, porcelain output, dry-run prune, and lock reasons. Returns command output as text.

branch.description: Optional branch name to create during add (-b)

lock.description: Optional: lock newly created worktree during add

porcelain.description: Optional: list output in porcelain format

tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Execute a shell command inside the portal working directory. Use for build tasks, test runners, or any operation not covered by dedicated tools. Returns combined stdout/stderr output and exit code.

tools.name: exaix_create_request
tools.description: Create a new Exaix request record (a work item to be planned and executed by an agent). Use when a user describes a task that needs agent execution. Mutating — requires human confirmation before execution. Returns the created request record with its assigned ID.

tools.name: exaix_list_plans
tools.description: List all execution plans (active, draft, or completed) tracked in the Exaix workspace. Read-only; safe for dynamic execution. Use to check plan status or find a plan ID before approving or querying. Returns an array of plan summary objects.

tools.name: exaix_approve_plan
tools.description: Approve or reject an execution plan, advancing it to the next state in the Exaix workflow. Use when a human has reviewed a plan and wants to authorize or cancel agent execution. Mutating — requires human confirmation before execution. Returns the updated plan record.

plan_id.description: ID of the plan to approve

tools.name: exaix_query_journal
tools.description: Query the Exaix activity journal for execution history, tool calls, or agent events. Read-only; safe for dynamic execution. Use to audit what happened or look up recent activity in a flow. Returns an array of matching journal entry records.

tools.name: exaix_config_get
tools.description: Read the current effective value of a single Exaix configuration key. Read-only; safe for dynamic execution. Use to inspect current config without starting the daemon. Returns the resolved value (override → registry default).

tools.name: exaix_config_validate
tools.description: Validate all registered configuration keys against their registry metadata (type, min, max, enum). Read-only; safe for dynamic execution. Use to confirm config is well-formed before applying changes or starting the daemon. Returns a validation report with any constraint violations.

tools.name: exaix_config_diff
tools.description: Compare effective configuration values against registry defaults. Read-only; safe for dynamic execution. Returns overridden, added, and missing keys. Use to see what config has been changed from defaults.

tools.name: exaix_config_get_provenance
tools.description: Trace the origin of a configuration key's value — whether it comes from a DB override, registry default, schema default, or bootstrap. Read-only; safe for dynamic execution. Use to explain why a key has its current value or debug unexpected config. Returns provenance source and resolved value.

tools.name: exaix_config_set
tools.description: Stage a configuration change for later activation. Use to propose a config mutation; the change is held in a per-session pending list and is NOT written until exaix_config_apply is called. Unapplied changes auto-discard after 60 seconds. Requires human approval before execution. Returns the staged key and status.

value.description: Value to set (number, string, or boolean)

tools.name: exaix_config_apply
tools.description: Apply all staged configuration changes from exaix_config_set. Use after staging one or more changes to commit them. Drains the pending list and writes each change through the config adapter. Requires human approval before execution. Returns a summary of applied and failed changes.

prompts.name: execute_plan
prompts.description: Execute an approved Exaix plan with guided steps

arguments.name: plan_id
arguments.description: UUID of the approved plan to execute

arguments.name: portal
arguments.description: Target portal name where plan will be executed

prompts.name: create_review
prompts.description: Create a review for code changes with git integration

arguments.name: portal
arguments.description: Portal name where changes will be made

prompts.name: commit_message
prompts.description: Generate a structured commit message for changes in a portal

arguments.name: portal
arguments.description: Portal name whose changes will be summarized
